title: The p-value, interactively demystified
description:
An illustrated, interactive journey through one of the most widely used (and most misunderstood) concepts in biology: the p-value.

You've heard about the p-value more times than you can count, and always wondered what it's really all about? Your wish is about to come true! This website is made for you. [Join me](https://tcoustillet.github.io/the-pvalue/) on a journey into the world of mathematics to demystify, once and for all, what the famous p-value actually is!

images.caption: Probability Refresher — for those who want to start off on the right foot
Introduction to the p-value — for those who want to understand the fundamentals
The p-value in action — for those who prefer concrete examples
Statistical tests — for those curious about how experimental science actually works
Beyond the p-value — for those who don’t want to get tripped up
